stanza: And the shallow water stretches as far as I can see
Knee deep, trudging along —
The seagull weeps ‘so long’ —
I’m humming a threshing song —

seagull.line: And while the seagulls are crying
seagull.lineNext: We fall but our souls are flying
stanza: Meet me on my vast veranda
My sweet, untouched Miranda
And while the seagulls are crying
We fall but our souls are flying

seagull.linePrev: In the sound of the waves and the cries
seagull.line: Of the seagulls circling the sand
seagull.lineNext: In the fragments of the songs
stanza: In the calling out to one another of the lovers
Up and down the strand
In the sound of the waves and the cries
Of the seagulls circling the sand
In the fragments of the songs
Carried down the wind from some radio
In the murmuring of the city in the distance
Ominous and low

seagull.linePrev: Protect my only light, for she once belonged to me
seagull.line: Let the waves rush in, let the seagulls cry
seagull.lineNext: For if I live again, these hopes will never die
stanza: Foghorn through the night, calling out to sea
Protect my only light, for she once belonged to me
Let the waves rush in, let the seagulls cry
For if I live again, these hopes will never die
I can feel you standing there
But I don't see you anywhere

seagull.linePrev: I'll break the ice in your skull, throw your corpse off the hull
seagull.line: You'll feed the seagulls, my words should be illegal I'm so lethal
seagull.lineNext: I got retrieval skills like a beagle, snatching the egg of an eagle
stanza: I may be introverted and shy but in my mind, lies, a consciousness
Where I got enough confidence
And competence to accomplish an entire continent
I got a horoscope of a broke metronome
I'm the holy ghost giving every note a home
I'll straighten out your head like a comb
I'm flowing Rivers like Joan
Get girls wet like boats, I float with ease
I got a whole lotta ways to cut the cheese
I got an army of chords and keys
I breathe these raps like breeze
I got your hands up like I told you to freeze
But unlike the police, I'm pro free
I'm digging tunnels underground where the moles be
Dip me like guacamole
I'm raising all you kids like Angelina Jolie
I'm a god, on the low key like a bass note
I was born in the winter I'm straight cold
I'll give you a splinter with a dull icicle
I'll break the ice in your skull, throw your corpse off the hull
You'll feed the seagulls, my words should be illegal I'm so lethal
I got retrieval skills like a beagle, snatching the egg of an eagle
Which I feed my people to lead past the cathedral to laugh in the face of evil
And I won't stop until the Devil lays peaceful
And all men are treated equal, I got a sequence of sequels
This is just the prequel of the needle
